d:
Mokama se jansuraj parti ke ummidvar piyush priydarshi ke samarthak dularchand yadav ki hatya aur jediyu ke bahubli neta anant sinh ki giraftari ke bad is ilaqe men chunav par iske asar ki charcha garam hai. ab mokama ilake men kaisa mahaul hai aur dularchand ki hatya se chunav par kitna asar parta dikh raha hai.
Dekhie bibisi sanvaddata rajnish kumar aur vidiyo jarnalist dipak jasrotiya ki yah graund riport.
• bibisi hindi se aap in soshal midiya chainals par bhi jur sakte hain-
